sections.title: IOCA Membership
sections.description: The Intercollegiate Outing Club Association was formed in 1932 to serve as a contact between college outing clubs. Today, the association still holds the same purpose: it allows larger clubs with expertise and equipment to help smaller clubs become more active, and helps new clubs get started with sample constitutions, bylaws, and ideas. Our goal now is to revive this community, and we need YOU to help us out! Fill out this form to join or reconnect with IOCA.
